_note: Viruses: injected mid-raid (Larva) for a strong effect plus a cost, lasting the rest of the raid, and visibly mutating the host. Integration (permanent, Viral Lab) arrives in Host. Multipliers are relative (1 = unchanged). Only one active virus at a time in Larva; injecting a second replaces the first. See docs/gdd/larva-milestone.md.

plagueStalkerStrain.label: Plague-Stalker Strain
plagueStalkerStrain.mutation: violet pustules spread up both forearms; the gun's crystal turns sickly green; footsteps leave glowing prints

adrenalineVirus.label: Adrenaline Virus
adrenalineVirus.mutation: veins swell amber under translucent skin and pulse with the heartbeat; antennae stiffen and twitch

splicedParasites.label: Spliced Parasites
splicedParasites.mutation: segmented larvae writhe under the skin of the forearms and burst out on kills
